name: flowpane
description: A live workflow pane: replaces the default Workflow progress list with a phase-by-phase graph or a timeline beside the transcript, showing each agent's state, timing, live token spend, tool calls, what it is saying, and prompt.

orientation.title: Layout
orientation.description: Which way the phases run: 'horizontal' (or 'across') runs them across the pane, 'vertical' (or 'down') runs them down it, 'timeline' draws bars against the clock, 'list' draws a row per agent instead of bands of cards, and 'auto' (or 'fits') follows the pane's shape. The settings dialog lists the five by name. The names these carried before 0.5.0 — 'flow', 'stack' and 'time' — still select their layouts.

detailRows.title: Detail height
detailRows.description: Rows the detail dialog takes when a node is selected (5 to 32), capped at what the pane can inset around it. Prompt and Tool Calls sit side by side; the answer takes a row of its own underneath.

paneRows.title: Pane height
paneRows.description: Rows the pane asks for (6 to 80). 0 lets the surface pick its own height, which is what a dock beside the transcript usually wants.
